card.name: Quantity words like nearly all, most of
card.fires_on: The word right after a vague quantity phrase, such as 'all' after nearly, almost or virtually, 'of' after 'more than 90%', or 'patients' after 'one in five'. It also fires on 'instances' after 'rare'.

modes.label: All after near-total words
modes.description: The word 'all' follows nearly, almost or virtually, to say that almost everything applies.
modes.example: were surgically performed and nearly<< all>> (91%) were performed before

modes.label: Noun or 'of' after a proportion
modes.description: The word after a fraction, percentage or 'rare' that names the group being counted.
modes.example: Only one in five<< patients>> who develop a serious upper GI adverse event

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning most, nearly all and often, so it lowers the chance of another 'most' style quantity word following.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a phrase like 'almost all' or 'one in five' where a proportion is being stated.
